successors.name: Tang dynasty
successors.text: Kucha, 'Conquered by the Tang dynasty: 648 CE', one of the Four Garrisons of Anxi

ledger.x: 2nd century BCE: the kingdom of Qiuci appears.

wars.name: Tang conquest of Kucha
wars.outcome: The Tang took Kucha in 648 and made it the seat of the Anxi Protectorate in 649; Karasahr had fallen by 644.

certainty.note: An oasis kingdom: the page names neighbours (Aksu, Kashgar, Karasahr, Turpan) and no border.

sources.title: Protectorate General to Pacify the West
